_comment: The slot machine of the brains gym (both gym sets use the same two tables). slotReels: the three reels, 13 symbols each, top to bottom as they come up (1..6 the stat symbols, 7 the jackpot; the reel length of 13 is fixed in the code). slotAssist: the help a new machine gets, one of these ten entries picked at random: 0 none, 1 the reels settle on the first symbol that completes a line, 2 they scan for jackpots. The payouts are training-gains.json's trainRules / train2Rules.
